name: 5dim_yeters
title: 5Dim's mod - Yeters
author: 5Dim
description:
Adds Yeters, a post-edge endgame planet for Space Age.
Unlocked with initial Promethium science, it concentrates late Space Age resources, lets crops grow on dedicated soils, adds a biochamber spoilage recipe and pauses item spoilage on its surface.
Requires Space Age and 5dim_core.
